//: The `app` service. Railway Config as Code is per-service, so this file
configures the one service Railway attaches this repository to.
IMPORTANT — read docs/RUNBOOK.md § Deployment topology before using this.
Railway deprecated Config as Code in favour of Infrastructure as Code
(.railway/railway.ts). Existing railway.json services keep working until
2026-12-01, and new services cannot opt in at all. The full three-service
topology — app, worker, Postgres — is written out as a railway.ts file in
the runbook, ready to lift. This file remains because it is the config the
app service reads today and because it records the deploy ordering that
must survive the migration to IaC.
The ordering that matters: preDeployCommand runs to completion before the
new version receives any traffic. Migrations are forward-only and never
edited after commit (CLAUDE.md), so they are safe to run against the old
version still serving — but the new version must never serve against an
un-migrated database, and that is what this ordering buys.
